chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Chapter 0612: Ji Ning's Chess Master Gambit - The Game of Attrition
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning switches tactics from brute force to an endless siege with the Eight Fires Universe. He then executes a brilliant strategy, hiding his incarnations in the chaos as a final survival plan.
og_title: The Attrition Game Begins: Ji Ning’s Ultimate Backup Plan
og_description: Ji Ning deploys a supreme treasure and a hidden stele, turning from an attacker into a long-game strategist in the World Prison.
twitter_title: Ji Ning just moved his King to safety. The ultimate clutch play.
twitter_description: Ji Ning uses an ancient treasure to trap a True Immortal, then secretly buries his own incarnations in the chaos for a final, unbreakable contingency.

lore_anchors.definition: A special prison used to confine beings from beyond the Three Realms, where the prisoners are cut off from cosmic energy and cannot replenish their mana.
A supreme-quality Pure Yang magic treasure forged by the Elder God Zhurong, containing the Eight Grand True Fires that can endlessly assault an enemy.
A primordial god of fire in Chinese mythology, known for his battle against the water god Gonggong. In Desolate Era, he is a powerful Elder God.
The supreme divine ability for transformation; at the ninth cycle, even beings at the Daofather level cannot see through the transformation remotely.
One of the two supreme stars in the Three Realms, representing the ultimate yin power source.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why can't the Dongjun True Immortal just break out of the Eight Fires Universe?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Because the prisoner in the World Prison is bound by Heavenly Locks rooted in their truesoul, making them unable to leave a fixed area, thus forced to endure the flames.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Is Ji Ning's backup plan actually effective?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Yes and no. The stele and its incarnations are nearly impossible to find in the chaos, but it is an 'insurance policy'; it doesn't help him win the current fight but ensures he survives total defeat.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Ji Ning need to contact Patriarch Subhuti?
cultural_notes_faq.a: This signals a larger strategic operation. Ji Ning is reporting his actions and likely planning his next moves against the Seamless Gate.
